svg.title: Architecture: Zero-Cost PaaS on Oracle Cloud Always Free
svg.desc: End-to-end architecture. Developer laptop provisions Oracle Cloud through the OCI API and administers the VM over SSH on the custom port. Git webhooks and internet users reach Traefik over HTTPS through the OCI Security List and the host firewall. Traefik routes to app containers and the Coolify control plane. systemd timers update DuckDNS, pull security feeds and send email alerts; Traefik obtains Let's Encrypt certificates. Animated dashes and dots show the direction of each flow.

g.text: Architecture: Zero-Cost PaaS on Oracle Cloud Always Free
Provisioned headlessly through the OCI API · one VM · Coolify as the PaaS layer · $0 per month
Moving dots show live flow direction
free-only tenancy · paid shapes limit 0 · $1 budget alert
A1 Ampere (target) · E2.1.Micro (stand-in) · up to 200 GB boot · 4 GB swap
drops 8000 · 6001 · 6002 · 8080 from the internet · blocks mining-pool egress
SNI routing · HTTP to HTTPS redirect
ACME resolver: per-host Let's Encrypt certificates
/data/coolify: config, certs (acme.json), SSH keys, logs · .env holds APP_KEY
